title: Design-repo for a design-faithful clone of a design-studio website template
versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion and tokenCatalogVersion are machine-checked by extraction/verify_all.py (must equal tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json and tokens/llm/token-catalog.json versions); pageSpecVersion is machine-checked against the schema const. repositoryVersion is documentation-only and hand-maintained.

designPolicy.contentHashMethod: extraction/policy_hash.py: for each contentHashFiles entry in order append '<path>\n<sha256 hex of bytes>\n'; contentHash = 'sha256:' + sha256 hex of that text. Recomputed and compared by extraction/verify_all.py (design-policy check).

decision.note: Category and classification are agent-derived and not human-reviewed; not an owner-ratified decision.

sourceStack.note: Documentation only. Never used for token names, section ids, schema fields or validator logic.
sourceStack.original: A no-code (Framer) website template served at the original template URL; the template author is credited in its footer.
sourceStack.clone: React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind CSS 3 with plain CSS files, a small custom client-side router (src/lib/router.js), Lenis smooth scroll at >=1200 only, self-hosted Inter Display / Inter fonts.
sourceStack.lockfile: package-lock.json (clean install: npm ci && npm run build)

sourceProject.kind: design-faithful clone of a commercial website template
sourceProject.cloneIdentity: reproduces the template's own fictional studio brand, copy and photography (no substitution)

external links point at the template author's link shortener
